Feature Guides
Emails
Automatically capture and file client emails. Store centrally for the practice. Use email templates and more.
Documents
Automate the creation and filing of documents. Use templates and powerful add-ins across the Office suite.
Search and Views
Search and display information using Lists, Views, and Filters, making it easy to manage your data.
Clients
Work from a dedicated client workspace to view documents, jobs, tasks and automations related to a client or group.
Tasks and Comments
Create, delegate and view tasks. Notifications when tasks are completed. Use Comments for questions and commentary.
Jobs
Display and maintain jobs within FYI. File documents at a job level.
Time and Billing
Add and manage time against your jobs. Manage WIP and invoice your clients.
Workflows
Enable the review and approval of emails and documents. Assign approval authority to partners or managers.
New Collaborate
Collaborate with your clients. Share documents and folders securely in a dedicated client portal on SharePoint.
Legacy Collaborate
From 31st May 2024, Legacy Collaborate has reached End-of-Support.
Process Automation
Use time-saving automations across document creation, import, filing, email communication and more!
Apps and Integrations
Connect FYI to your favourite apps.
Employee Management
Manage secure records for your team, and efficiently onboard new staff.
Reporting
Efficiently create detailed Excel reports using a range of Report Templates.
Forms
Create and manage custom forms. Completed forms are filed to clients and employees.
